title: Every git fetch of land, not only the main one, runs once more after a failure
goal: The code-branch fetch, the pushed-tip fetch, the wait-merge poll fetch and the registered-repository fetch of bl_land go through land_git_fetch's one retry, so a single timeout in the wait-merge poll no longer ends the wait, as ST-tnickxo3 gate g1's answer (any failed git fetch of land runs once more) says

run:
import re, sys
src = open("_tools/bl_land.py", encoding="utf-8").read()
n = len(re.findall(r"land_git_network\([^)]*\"fetch\"", src)) + len(re.findall(r"run_git_bounded\(\(\"fetch\"", src)) + len(re.findall(r"repo_network\([^)]*\"fetch\"", src))
print("fetch calls outside land_git_fetch:", n)
sys.exit(1 if n else 0)
